referenceSources.description:
A silver Fiat Tipo 2.0 16v five-door hatchback is displayed in a studio setting, highlighting its clean lines and period‑correct styling. The black plastic bumpers and side moldings contrast with the light body color, while the five‑spoke alloy wheels add a sporty touch. Badges on the rear identify it as a 16‑valve model, reflecting the performance focus of early 1990s compact cars.

This image appears in a Carwow feature marking the 30th anniversary of Expo ’92 in Seville, where automakers exhibited prototypes and production vehicles in architecturally notable pavilions. The article revisits those displays and imagines their modern counterparts, celebrating the role of cars like the Fiat Tipo in that historic event.
